question: How long do I have to get a refund on a monthly plan?
reference: Monthly plans are refundable in full within 30 days of the charge.

question: Where do I download an invoice?
reference: Invoices are under Settings > Billing > Invoices.

question: Can I move a seat to a different person?
reference: An account owner reassigns a seat from Settings > Members; the seat is not re-billed.

question: Is there a cooling-off period on the annual plan?
reference: There is no cooling-off period. Annual plans are refundable in full within 30 days of the charge and not at all after that.

question: Do you support SAML?
reference: SAML SSO is available on the Scale tier, configured from Settings > Security.

question: What happens if my card is declined?
reference: We retry the charge on days 3 and 7, then suspend the workspace on day 10.

question: If I sign up for a year and change my mind in the first fortnight, what happens?
reference: There is no cooling-off period. Annual plans are refundable in full within 30 days of the charge and not at all after that.

question: Where is our data stored?
reference: Account data is held in the region selected at signup: EU, US or AP.

question: If I cancel an annual plan halfway through, do I get half my money back?
reference: No. Annual plans are refunded in full within 30 days of the charge and are not prorated after that.

question: How do I add a teammate?
reference: An account owner adds members from Settings > Members; new seats are prorated on the next invoice.

question: A colleague said there is a two-week window to back out of an annual contract. Is that right?
reference: There is no cooling-off period. Annual plans are refundable in full within 30 days of the charge and not at all after that.

question: Is data encrypted at rest?
reference: Data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
